name: elysia-module
description: Modular monolith boundary convention — one Postgres schema per module via drizzle/schemas/<module>.schema.ts, no cross-schema foreign keys, cross-module access restricted to schema types and public DI tokens, external systems behind contract ports, module-owned queues writing through the module repository, and the Better Auth exception for user/organization modules with a declared write-surface invariant.
author: OpenAgentic
